LESSON: READING READINESS SKILLS

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Book handling By the end of the sub-strand, the • Learners could be engaged in a
Topic 3.2: Reading readiness skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Reading readiness skills. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when opening a page. video for self-assessment. reading?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate top-down orientation skills when reading.
2. Turn pages from right to left when opening a page.
3. Enjoy participating in pre- reading activities in and out of school. looking at pictures from left to right, moving the eye from top-to-bottom of the page and turning pages from right to left.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Demonstrate top-down orientation skills when reading.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate top-down orientation skills when reading. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Turn pages from right to left when opening a page.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to turn pages from right to left when opening a page. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Enjoy participating in pre- reading activities in and out of school. looking at pictures from left to right, moving the eye from top-to-bottom of the page and turning pages from right to left.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to enjoy participating in pre- reading activities in and out of school. looking at pictures from left to right, moving the eye from top-to-bottom of the page and turning pages from right to left. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Reading readiness skills.
2. Explain Reading readiness skills to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading readiness skills.
4. Show that you can: Demonstrate top-down orientation skills when reading.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading readiness skills. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when opening a page. video for self-assessment. reading?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Demonstrate top-down orientation skills when reading.
2. Turn pages from right to left when opening a page.
3. Enjoy participating in pre- reading activities in and out of school. looking at pictures from left to right, moving the eye from top-to-bottom of the page and turning pages from right to left.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
